label: TP
reason: User-controlled header data flows through URL decoding into a variable used directly in encodeForHTML(), which outputs unescaped content via PrintWriter. The ESAPI encoder protects the cryptographic payload but does not sanitize the original user input 'bar' before it reaches the HTML sink.

evidence.note: User input from headers flows through decode() into bar, then into encodeForHTML() sink without proper sanitization of the user portion
